meta.title: Projects — United Mekong JSC
meta.description: Case studies from offshore, port, shipbuilding and heavy-lift projects supplied by United Mekong JSC.

hero.headline: Trusted across industries, project after project
hero.subhead: From offshore FPSO topside lifts to port crane rigging and shipyard block erection — we deliver certified gear and documentation to keep your operations moving.

sectors.title: Offshore & FPSO
sectors.desc: Wire rope slings, shackles, and crane rigging sets for FPSO mooring, topside lifts, and subsea installation. Familiar with IMCA M 179 and DNV-ST-N001.
sectors.clients: FPSO operators · Rig contractors · DSV support

sectors.title: Port & Terminal
sectors.desc: Container spreader slings, quay crane rigging, and general cargo gear for Vung Tau, Cái Mép, and HCMC port facilities.

sectors.title: Shipbuilding & Repair
sectors.desc: Launch and drydock rigging, block-erection sling sets, and chain blocks for shipyards across Southeast Asia.

sectors.title: Heavy Lift & Construction
sectors.desc: Multi-leg sling sets, beam spreaders, and turnbuckle assemblies for onshore heavy-lift, civil construction, and petrochemical plant erection.
